mirror_norms.proof: The coefficient epsilon=1+sqrt(2) is a unit and N(A11 D7 E6) is even unimodular. The primitive pairing-ideal divisibility q(r)|2I(r), together with the dyadic parity argument, leaves valuations zero and two. Totally-positive units are squares. Hence the complete canonical primitive mirror norms are 1 and 2.
